subject: Approval needed: Update Zoom Pro payment card
body: Hi Arif, could you please approve updating the payment card for our Zoom Pro plan? The previous card was declined, and service will pause on Wednesday 25 November at 23:59 if not updated. Since all our live sessions run on Zoom, we need this sorted promptly. Thanks! Best, Hamid, PoliPrep

subject: Re: Refund request, CEnT-S course
body: Hello, thank you for reaching out. Under our withdrawal policy, a full refund is only available within 14 days if the student has not started the course. Since your son has already watched the first classes, we are unable to issue a full refund. Best regards, Hamid, PoliPrep

subject: CEnT-S Cohort 1 & Black Friday details
body: Hi there, Cohort 1 has at most 20 students and runs from 1 November 2026 to 7 February 2027. The Black Friday price for CEnT-S is €399 from 23 to 30 November 2026 (23:59 Rome) with no code needed. Best regards, Ulu, PoliPrep
